text: Lamun aya sémah uluk salam “Sampurasun!”, biasana diwaler ku …
gloss: If a guest greets with “Sampurasun!”, the usual reply is… — Rampés: the fixed Sundanese answer to the greeting.

text: Janjian “tabuh satengah dalapan” hartina kudu datang tabuh sabaraha?
gloss: An appointment at “half eight” means arriving at what time? — 7:30: Sundanese counts the half hour towards the coming hour.

text: “Salawé” ditambah lima, jadi sabaraha?
gloss: “Salawé” plus five makes how many? — Thirty: salawé is the native word for 25.

text: Lanceuk ti bapa urang, ku urang disebut …
gloss: Your father's older sibling is called… — uwa: an older sibling of a parent is uwa; a younger brother is emang/mamang.

text: Pakarang tradisional naon nu gambarna aya dina lambang Provinsi Jawa Barat?
gloss: Which traditional weapon appears on the West Java provincial emblem? — The kujang, the Sundanese blade.

text: Dina dongéng Sunda, saha ngaran pamajikan Si Kabayan?
gloss: In Sundanese folk tales, who is Si Kabayan's wife? — Nyi Iteung; the others belong to other Sundanese legends.

text: Wayang golék, nu tokohna kayaning Cépot jeung Dawala, dijieunna tina …
gloss: Wayang golek puppets, with characters like Cepot and Dawala, are made of… — wood (wayang kulit is the leather one).

text: Peuyeum Bandung nu sok digantung-gantung di warung sisi jalan dijieun tina …
gloss: Peuyeum Bandung, hung up at roadside stalls, is made from… — cassava, fermented with ragi.

text: Kota Bogor kawentar ku jujulukna, nyaéta Kota …
gloss: Bogor is known by its nickname, the City of… — Rain; Kembang is Bandung, Santri Tasikmalaya, Udang Cirebon.

text: Domba nu tandukna galing tur kawentar dina adu ketangkasan téh domba …
gloss: The sheep with curled horns famous in agility contests is the … sheep — Garut.

text: Tabung gas LPG 3 kg nu disubsidi pamaréntah warnana …
gloss: The subsidised 3 kg LPG cylinder is coloured… — green (the “gas melon”); 12 kg was blue, Bright Gas pink.

text: Konferénsi Asia Afrika taun 1955 diayakeun di kota …
gloss: The 1955 Asian–African Conference was held in… — Bandung, at Gedung Merdeka.

text: Dina kode OTP nu dikirim ka HP, hurup “O” téh singgetan tina …
gloss: In an OTP code sent to your phone, the “O” stands for… — One: One-Time Password.

text: Dina WhatsApp, centang dua nu robah jadi biru hartina pesen urang geus …
gloss: In WhatsApp, two ticks turning blue means the message has been… — read (grey double ticks mean delivered).

text: Pokémon Pikachu kaasup tipe naon?
gloss: What type of Pokémon is Pikachu? — Electric.

text: Pamaén bal nu ngasupkeun tilu gol dina hiji patandingan disebut nyieun …
gloss: A footballer scoring three goals in one match has made a… — hat-trick (a brace is two).

text: Gelembung dina inuman bersoda téh eusina gas …
gloss: The bubbles in a fizzy drink contain… — carbon dioxide.

text: Kartun “Upin & Ipin” dijieun di nagara …
gloss: The cartoon “Upin & Ipin” is made in… — Malaysia (Les' Copaque, Kuala Lumpur).

text: Aplikasi naon nu bisa mikawanoh judul lagu nu keur kadéngé, ngan ku nyorongkeun HP?
gloss: Which app can recognise the title of a song you are hearing, just by holding up your phone? — Shazam.

text: Pulo Papua dibagi dua: beulah kulon kaasup Indonésia, beulah wétan kaasup nagara …
gloss: New Guinea is split: the west is Indonesia, the east is… — Papua New Guinea.

text: Baking powder dina adonan kuéh gunana pikeun …
gloss: Baking powder in cake batter is there to… — make the batter rise.

text: Dina carita Ramayana, Déwi Sinta diculik ku …
gloss: In the Ramayana, Sita is abducted by… — Rahwana (Ravana).

text: Lauk naon nu bisa ngagelembungkeun awakna nepi ka buleud lamun keur bahaya?
gloss: Which fish can puff itself up into a ball when threatened? — The pufferfish (buntal).

text: Dina baskét, bal nu asup tina lémparan ti luar garis lengkung méré sabaraha poin?
gloss: In basketball, a shot from beyond the arc scores how many points? — 3.

text: Dina pilem animasi “Frozen”, saha ngaran manusa salju nu ngimpi ngarasakeun usum panas?
gloss: In “Frozen”, what is the snowman who dreams of summer called? — Olaf (Sven is the reindeer).

text: Kimchi, kadaharan has Koréa, paling umum dijieun tina …
gloss: Kimchi, the Korean staple, is most commonly made from… — napa cabbage (sawi bodas).

text: Térmométer digital nu ditodongkeun kana tarang ngukur suhu awak ngaliwatan …
gloss: A digital thermometer pointed at the forehead measures body temperature through… — infrared radiation given off by the skin.

text: Lamun di warung aya tulisan “QRIS”, hartina urang bisa …
gloss: If a shop shows a “QRIS” sign, it means you can… — pay by scanning a code: QRIS is Indonesia's national QR payment standard, accepted by any bank or e-wallet app.

text: Di Bandung keur tabuh 20.00 WIB. Di Makassar, nu kaasup WITA, tabuh sabaraha?
gloss: It is 20:00 WIB in Bandung. What time is it in Makassar (WITA)? — 21:00: WITA is one hour ahead of WIB.

text: Motif batik “mega mendung” nu ngagambarkeun awan asalna ti …
gloss: The “mega mendung” cloud batik motif comes from… — Cirebon.

text: Taman Nasional Ujung Kulon di Banten jadi tempat hirup panungtungan pikeun sato langka …
gloss: Ujung Kulon National Park in Banten is the last home of the rare… — Javan rhinoceros.

text: Loba ngaran tempat di Tatar Sunda dimimitian ku “Ci-”, saperti Cianjur jeung Cimahi. “Ci” téh tina kecap …
gloss: Many Sundanese place names start with “Ci-”, like Cianjur and Cimahi. “Ci” comes from the word… — cai, water.

text: Karédok jeung gado-gado sarua disiram ku sambel suuk. Bédana, sayuran karédok mah …
gloss: Karedok and gado-gado both get peanut sauce. The difference: karedok's vegetables are… — raw.

text: Palabuhan Karajaan Sunda nu kiwari jadi Jakarta ngaranna …
gloss: The Sunda Kingdom's harbour that grew into Jakarta was called… — Sunda Kalapa.

text: Dina kapercayaan Sunda buhun, Nyi Pohaci Sanghyang Sri téh déwi …
gloss: In old Sundanese belief, Nyi Pohaci Sanghyang Sri is the goddess of… — rice.

text: Bandéra nagara mana nu ampir sarua jeung Sang Saka Merah Putih, ngan babandinganana nu béda?
gloss: Which country's flag is almost identical to Indonesia's, differing only in proportions? — Monaco (Poland is white over red).

text: Di luhur gunung, cai ngagolak dina suhu nu leuwih handap batan di basisir. Naon sababna?
gloss: Up a mountain water boils at a lower temperature than on the coast. Why? — Lower air pressure.

text: Dina notasi musik, tanda “♯” nu naékkeun nada satengah disebut …
gloss: In notation, the “♯” sign raising a note by a semitone is called… — kres (sharp); mol is flat, pugar natural.

text: Dina novél Cervantes, Don Quixote narajang … nu disangkana raksasa.
gloss: In Cervantes's novel, Don Quixote charges at … he takes for giants — windmills.

text: Dina ténis, skor nol disebut …
gloss: In tennis, a score of zero is called… — love.

text: Kotak CAPTCHA dina hiji situs gunana pikeun mastikeun yén nu muka téh …
gloss: A CAPTCHA box on a website checks that the visitor is… — not a robot.

text: Abad ka-21 sacara resmi dimimitian taun …
gloss: The 21st century officially began in… — 2001: there is no year 0, so centuries run 1–100, 2001–2100.

text: Lagu “Manuk Dadali” diciptakeun ku …
gloss: The song “Manuk Dadali” was written by… — Sambas Mangundikarta.

text: Susi Susanti, pamaén bulu tangkis asal Tasikmalaya, meunang medali emas Olimpiade di kota …
gloss: Susi Susanti, the badminton player from Tasikmalaya, won Olympic gold in… — Barcelona (1992), Indonesia's first Olympic gold.

text: Pupuh nu watekna kanyaah, birahi, atawa cinta téh …
gloss: The pupuh (verse form) whose mood is love and longing is… — Asmarandana; Durma is anger, Maskumambang sorrow, Pucung advice.

text: Sabaraha rupa PIN opat angka nu bisa dijieun tina angka 0 nepi ka 9?
gloss: How many four-digit PINs can be made from the digits 0–9? — 10,000 (0000–9999); 5,040 would forbid repeats.

text: Dina astronomi, “taun cahaya” téh ukuran …
gloss: In astronomy, a “light-year” measures… — distance: how far light travels in a year.

text: Genep “tusuk saté” dina puncak Gedung Saté di Bandung ngalambangkeun …
gloss: The six “satay skewers” on top of Gedung Sate in Bandung stand for… — its building cost of six million guilders.

text: Saha nu nyiptakeun World Wide Web di CERN taun 1989?
gloss: Who invented the World Wide Web at CERN in 1989? — Tim Berners-Lee. Vint Cerf, the trap, co-designed the internet's TCP/IP protocols, which the Web runs on.

text: Taun 1810 puseur Kabupatén Bandung dipindahkeun ti Dayeuhkolot ka sisi Jalan Raya Pos. Saha bupatina?
gloss: In 1810 the seat of Bandung regency moved from Dayeuhkolot to the Great Post Road. Who was the regent? — R.A. Wiranatakusumah II (Dalem Kaum), founder of the city; Pangeran Kornel ruled Sumedang.
